_comment: Every human call in the run, in one file. This is the ONLY file that should differ run to run. Delete this key before running - unknown keys are a hard error. Every key below is optional. NOTE: parent_control_confirmed and parent_control_inferred neither disqualify nor route - they are recorded in ownership and stated at the front of verdict.

competitor.example-staffing.com: Core business is contract staffing and direct placement; the careers page and the services page both sell recruiting and staff augmentation.

distress.example-winddown.com: Announced closure of all three offices on 2026-08-14; the site now serves a wind-down notice.

parent_control_confirmed.example-division.com: Careers page redirects to the parent's ATS and the open Regional Sales Manager requisition is posted under the parent legal entity.

parent_control_inferred.example-brand.com: About page reads 'an Acme company' and the LinkedIn name carries the parent, but the company keeps its own careers page, its own leadership and its own domain.

pe_recent.example-recap.com: Recapitalised 2026-04; the sponsor installed its own operating partner as CEO in June.

pe_backed.example-portfolio.com: Growth investment 2022-09; management still leads and the company buys independently.

serial_acquirer.example-unit.com: Held by a decentralised perpetual acquirer; the unit keeps its own P&L, leadership and careers page.

b2c.example-dtc.com: Pure transactional DTC retail, no relationship-sales motion.

left.12345: Employment history shows the role ended 2026-05. Backfill the correct persona at this company and score the new employer separately.

unverifiable.12346: Not placeable at this company by identifier, LinkedIn URL, email or name-at-domain.

mismatch_review.12347: The list, Apollo and the company site name three different employers. Confirm before outreach.

domain_confirmed.example-legacy.com: Checked 2026-09-20 - the mail domain is a legacy brand; the site, the LinkedIn page and the phone number all resolve to the same company.

12348.record_caveats: RECORD CORRECTED: CRM shows an Appointment in 2025-11 that the export did not carry.
